Here's a short patient-facing note for the teaching refill lab:

Dear [Patient A's Name],

We have received your request for a refill of your lisinopril medication. Our system has reviewed your chart and determined that we can fulfill your request.

Please note that we are a teaching pharmacy, which means we use a unique system to review and approve refill requests. This process is designed to ensure your safety and the accuracy of your medication.

We will now send a renewal request for your script to your prescriber. Your prescriber will review the request and make a decision. If approved, we will process your refill.

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for entrusting us with your care.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
